text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I placed, huh? All the other runners were amazing in their own right. But I guess that makes sense since they qualified for this race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've learned a lot from all of them—even if it's hard to put into words what that is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I need to work even harder if I wanna put it to good use!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I need to work even harder if I wanna put it to good use!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I didn't mean to sound like I'm rushing… But you're right. It wouldn't be good to throw off my current pace.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Folks back home used to say stuff like that all the time. "Don't overdo it." "Health comes first." Y'know, the usual…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …Okay, it's decided. I'm gonna eat more than usual before the next race so I'll be at my best!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I wanna get even faster and compete with Umamusume from all over.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The better I become, the more fun I'll have, and the more exciting it'll be for everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If it's effort I need, then I'll give it all the effort I've got. Your guidance means a lot to me, so make sure to pull out all the stops!
